result.topic_en: Tables for primes of the forms 24n+1, 5, 13, 17, 7, 11, 19, 23 that give, for each twelfth (or thirteenth) of the range, an expression of the form k/2·n + const plus fractional multiples of auxiliary quantities a, b, c, d. This is apparently the count of residues in each subinterval, in connection with biquadratic residues.

methods.what: Tabulation, for primes in each residue class mod 24, of the number of residues in successive twelfths (thirteenths) of the range. Each count is a linear expression in n plus fractional combinations of auxiliary quantities a, b, c, d.
